templates.title: Reassurance talk track
templates.subject: Owner reassurance
templates.body:
The estimate commits the owner to nothing. No data moves before a signed scope. They keep ownership and approve every deal in writing. Any system can be left out. A third-party specialist is contemplated for de-identification, subject to agreement. There are no upfront fees.

Never say the data is definitely legal to sell or 100 percent anonymous. Explain the rights review, written boundary, and limits of de-identification.

templates.title: Phone script
templates.subject: A plain opener
templates.body:
I am calling because you may already own operating records that AI labs could license. I am not asking you to send files. DataQuire can show an honest range first, and you decide whether another conversation is worthwhile.

If they are interested, send [Your referral link]. If they decline, thank them and leave them alone.
